meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: Claude 在成功执行代码编辑后，会接收注释检查器的反馈；若收到警告，必须先修复或解释被标记的注释，之后才能继续。
howto.when: 当执行 apply_patch、write、edit 等编辑操作成功，且注释检查器报告警告时触发。

say.text: 请修复注释检查器报告的注释问题。
say.note: Claude 会定位并修改被标记的注释。

say.text: 解释为什么这条注释可以保留。
say.note: Claude 会说明理由，然后继续。

say.text: 根据检查器警告修改代码注释。

howto.what_en: After a successful code edit, Claude receives comment-checker feedback; if a warning is issued, it must fix or explain the flagged comment before proceeding.
howto.when_en: Triggered after a successful edit-like tool call (apply_patch, write, edit, etc.) when the comment checker reports a warning.

say_en.text: Please fix the comment issue reported by the checker.
say_en.note: Claude will locate and update the flagged comment.

say_en.text: Explain why this comment can stay.
say_en.note: Claude will justify it and then continue.

say_en.text: Update the code comment based on the checker warning.
